name: A repeated delivery of a held transfer adds no queue item
title: SC-07-03-04 A repeated delivery of a held transfer adds no queue item
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given a transfer is held UNMATCHED for several open debtors
When the bank webhook sends the same transaction id again
Then the delivery is reported as a duplicate and the queue still holds one item
